description: A box-shadow with a real declared blur radius, validating this crate's own hand-rolled Gaussian blur against Chromium's real rendering — no text, so pixel comparison is this fixture's precise signal.

classification.reason: Two independent Gaussian blur implementations (this crate's own hand-rolled one vs. Chromium's) never round every pixel identically along the shadow's own soft gradient, where a difference of 1 unit out of 255 is the whole story: measured live against Chromium at 4.68% differing pixels, every single one of them off by exactly 1 (max_error: 1, mean_error: 0.0468) — sub-perceptible rounding noise, not a shape or position mismatch, comfortably under this threshold.
